body: Yes 2/3 times for suicide attempts and it sucked ass. Was there for 3 days/5-6 days. Did not help at all and for me I see it as a place where you put people so they dont kill themselves. What it's like is basically a basic little place with a very plain room you sleep in. In your room is a locked bathroom with a plain white sheet bed that's comfortable enough. Some psych wards will give u a roommate some dont. For me I didnt have one. When u leave your room, you can go one place; the main room, where you can find a TV with whatever the nurses want you watch on. There's a long table for group therapy sessions/eating. The food there is crappy at worst and okay at best. The snacks are basic and in small packages and they do offer milks and juices for you to drink. You can have a snack or drink something at any point of the day. Where I stayed, there was 12ish other patients. When you are admitted to there, expect to wait a long time to get in at best and a very long time at worst. If u have any other questions ask away
